user_direction: Some images are placeholders until better concepts are created. Inventory presence is not selection for use.
status_boundary: Specific image ranking is internal judgment. User did not identify individual files; no per-image owner selection/rejection is invented. No replacement generation is authorized by this assessment.

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Readable monumental interior and void; sparse generic architecture supplies atmosphere but little distinctive modular production information.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Lighting, scale contrast and floor-void mood; redesign into mission-specific structures before production.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Strong focal composition, but ornate hovering platform and bright central crystal are cinematic studies with unresolved gameplay topology.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Fractured sun and platform hierarchy; do not adopt ornaments or geometry as final canon.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Dense invented telemetry and inconsistent miniature text; a polished screenshot appearance masks unverified flows and numbers.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep broad map/dossier/ledger grouping as a UI question; replace the screen concept with requirement-grounded original UI.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Repeated magenta crystalline shapes and strong glow risk making four functions hard to distinguish; annotations do not settle scale or coherence behavior.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep exploratory phase architecture; strengthen independent functional silhouettes before selecting a design.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Three readable columns supply useful contrast, but heavy glow, invented labels and similar impact effects do not establish gameplay timing or distinct ability identity.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain faction effect-language ideas; redesign individual event effects for shape, timing and tactical readability.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Generic war-room framing, tiny invented text and ambiguous representative units; the three cards do not define canonical faction models.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Preserve card/information hierarchy ideas, but replace ambiguous unit depictions and layout before production.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Large luminous spiral overwhelms the battlefield and differs from the distinct four-state design; surrounding forces have ambiguous identity.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep dramatic environmental reaction ideas, but redesign for shared state identity, hierarchy and RTS legibility.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: The lighter contextual arc is useful, but cropped commands, tiny telemetry and generic squat mechs leave important design decisions unresolved.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep battlefield openness and contextual interaction idea; revise actual controls and replace unsupported mechs.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Derivative three-box console, crowded combat and unsupported Atlas Mech label conflict with the active original-HUD direction.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Comparison history only; do not use as final UI or unit-design target.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Extreme annotated heights, mountain-like dome and inconsistent scale push structures away from the readable rooted/migratory gameplay brief.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep strata/root/growth language; replacement or substantial redesign of scale/proportions is likely needed.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Mara/command-bridge atmosphere is useful, but dense holographic menu text and generic scene details do not define a final menu or modeling reference.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain Mara portrayal as a candidate and bridge mood separately; rework interface and obtain dedicated character references.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Derivative menu/profile/currency treatment and generic armored portrait do not establish Echoes identity; unsupported names and franchise-like framing.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain comparison history only; replace with original approved design if this screen is produced.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Useful object separation, but excessive cyan glow, decorative surface detail and mismatched footprint annotations weaken production reliability.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep selected architectural ideas as alternatives; resolve scale and silhouette against the original sheet and gameplay source.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Invented objective names and resource rows, dense text and borrowed menu conventions make this a wireframe-like placeholder despite rendered polish.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Ledger metaphor and objective grouping only; create a clearer requirement-grounded concept later.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Unsupported Lyra/Atlas labels, crowded tiny charts, contradictory metrics and generic dashboard composition are not a trustworthy final target.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Keep telemetry categories as discussion material; replace portrait, unit and information design after requirements review.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Small busy text, numeric/loudness assumptions and a cinematic monitor frame prioritize screenshot styling over a usable settings design.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain accessibility categories; redraw an original readable settings concept with verified controls.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Same recognizable object identity across four geometric states is stronger production information than a single generic glow effect.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Preserve the full family and state separation; approval and state-transition development still required.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Separated route studies provide distinct traversable shapes and material identities, though exact terrain dimensions are unresolved.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Preserve route design history; reconcile with authored current map topology.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Distinct civic, mobile, nursery and detection forms; clean separated silhouettes are useful for production discussion.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain; establish scale and functional state references.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Distinct isolated bodies and mineral language; appendages and silhouette differences provide useful starting references.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain; resolve roster/form conflicts and details before modeling.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Four individually readable structures, coherent material palette and separated masses; precise production dimensions remain absent.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain; compare alternate architecture proposals without overwriting this source.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Clear isolated silhouettes and material language; these are stronger object references, but conflict with some later catalog body-type descriptions.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain original designs for owner selection; no automatic replacement or adoption.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Strong landscape mood and ground-cover movement; distant creatures and architecture are too small to define production geometry.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Vegetation flow, basalt terraces and megafauna scale relationship; needs separate object references.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Illustrative region icons and heavy route glow resemble a presentation mockup; geography, labels and spatial relationships are not controlled by current map data.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain regional ideas/history only. A better canon-controlled map is needed before use as geographic or game-facing authority.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Coherent composed world/roster/landmark target; closer camera and strong effects are not tactical or performance validation.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain as composition reference; incomplete provenance prevents production-use clearance.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Useful cavern composition, but dense glow, tiny units and saturated crystal clutter do not establish tactical readability or exact object construction.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Rock/geode/road relationships; simplify and develop individual objects later.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06

assessments.observed_weakness_or_strength: Strong atmospheric world identity and hierarchy, but distant figures/architecture are intentionally underspecified.
assessments.recommended_treatment: Retain mood and world-design history; do not invent identities or use as a modeling sheet.
assessments.assessment_basis: Internal visual review against project art/RTS direction and user clarification on 2026-09-06
